turnos.t: Mercadona and Inditex are both huge. Why can I only buy shares in one of them?

Because Mercadona is a privately held company. Its shares are sold privately to people the owners choose, and aren't traded on a stock exchange. Inditex is publicly held: its shares trade on the stock exchange, so anyone can buy them.
So publicly held just means bigger?
No, size doesn't define the type. Going public raises much more capital, but the accounts are published and the company can be taken over.
